_doc.purpose: Hand-curated landmark list. This file is the source of truth and is meant to be edited by hand — build-landmarks.mjs only fills in coordinates, it never rewrites your entries.
workflow: 1. Edit this list: add/remove landmarks, fix names, set tier/icon/min_zoom.
3. It resolves any entry missing lat/lon via Nominatim and writes them back here, marked "verified": false.
4. Check each unverified coordinate on the map, correct it if wrong, set "verified": true.
5. Re-run to emit build/data/landmarks.geojson. Unverified entries are still emitted but reported.

fields.name: Display name, as shown in search and on the map.
fields.tier: 1 = drawn custom icon, most prominent. 2 = generic icon.
fields.icon: Sprite id in landmarks/icons/. Several landmarks may share one.
fields.min_zoom: Zoom at which the icon starts appearing.
fields.description: One short line, shown when the landmark is selected.
fields.query: Optional Nominatim search string, when the display name alone is ambiguous.
fields.lat/lon: Filled by the resolver; edit freely. null = unresolved.
fields.verified: Set true once you have eyeballed the coordinate on the map.

_doc.min_zoom_note: Defaults follow DECISIONS/STATUS: only Turning Torso and Öresundsbron at z11 (the spec's z11–12 is 'district names, almost nothing else'), other Tier-1 at z12, Tier-2 at z13. Tune with the map visible.
